title: Medicare Benefits Schedule Review Advisory Committee - MBS Time Tiered Items Draft Report
overview:
The Medicare Benefits Schedule (MBS) is a list of health professional services (items) that the Australian Government subsidises. MBS items provide patient benefits for a wide range of health services including consultations, diagnostic tests, therapy, and operations.

Established in 2021, the MBS Continuous Review is a program assurance function that conducts ongoing reviews of the MBS to ensure it is contemporary, aligned with best clinical practice, improves patient outcomes, and supports high quality care for all Australians.

overview:

title: Local government aged care providers feedback
overview:
The Department of Health, Disability and Ageing are working with local government aged care providers to transition to the new Act. 

This consultation will ensure we understand local government provider perspectives around the upcoming reforms and can help you transition to the new system. This will help the government understand the issues you are facing, and to understand information gaps, logistical issues or financial barriers for local government providers as we undergo this significant transformation of Australia’s aged care system.
